name: VR Headset
summary: Generic VR visor headset with two lenses and a strap; use for virtual reality, gaming or metaverse scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the visor base is at y; set y to a table or hand height to place it

params.name: s
params.note: scale; hero size, about 600 px wide at s = 1; use about 0.4 on a person's head

params.name: anim
params.note: float = drifts gently up and down
